name: @w6w-apps/avoma
description: Read Avoma meetings, recordings, transcripts, AI notes, insights, scorecards and users, and submit call recordings for analysis.

w6w.longDescription:
Avoma is an AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes customer conversations. This app lets a workflow pull that conversation data out: list meetings in a date window by attendee, CRM association or call type, then read each meeting's transcript, AI-generated notes, keyword insights, sentiment, topic segments and expiring recording URLs.

It also covers the coaching side — scorecard templates and the evaluations completed against meetings — plus the organization's users and smart categories. For teams with their own dialer, a workflow can submit a call recording to Avoma for transcription and analysis, look the call up again by its external id, and remove Avoma's notetaker bot from a meeting it is attending.

Avoma's API requires a date window on its main list endpoints and rate-limits to 60 requests a minute, so the actions validate dates up front and page by the vendor's own next-page URL. Avoma publishes no status page, so health is tracked by an unauthenticated reachability check on the API plus the credential check.
